The chart is based on each song's weekly physical and digital sales collectively, the amount of ... Fifteen artists managed to reach the number one spot on the chart in 2025, with six― Tate McRae , Alex ... the first time. Lamar is the only artist to chart two number one songs during the year. The year was marked by little to no movement on the charts, with a huge number of songs lingering around or having been released the previous year, making 2025 one of the most stagnant years for popular music in Billboard chart history.
